name: study2_cohort_vhir
title: Emergency Department Visits with Diagnosis of Heart Failure
description: This cohort includes adult patients visiting the Emergency Department (whether or not the visit led to a hospital admission). The reference time point is the end of the Emergency Department visit. All patients in this cohort are assumed to have heart failure.

entity.name: pid
entity.description: A unique identifier assigned to each patient in the cohort.

entity.name: encounterId
entity.description: A unique identifier for each hospital encounter.

entry.name: patientEmergencyEncounter
entry.description: Captures ambulatory visits/encounters to the Emergency Department.

period.description: Includes all encounters for the defined cohort population.

eligibility.name: adults
eligibility.description: Exclude Patients who are younger than 18 years old at the time of the visit.
